name: ui
title_zh: 把任何界面改到能直接上线的视觉打磨器
tagline_zh: 截图丢进来，丑界面变生产级 UI。字体、间距、层次一次到位，不用再跟设计师来回拉扯。
tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get production-grade UI. Typography, spacing, hierarchy—done in one pass, no design ping-pong.
desc_en: Produces distinctive, production-grade UI for pages, components, visual interfaces, typography, and screenshot-driven polish. Use when users ask in any language for UI, page, component, frontend, typography, screenshot-grounded visual polish, or complaints that a screen looks unclear, ugly, inconsistent, or visually wrong. Not for backend logic or data pipelines.
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是从截图反推视觉系统，按你的产品语境重排层级。比通用组件库更懂‘这一屏’该长什么样。
why_en: No templates—it reverse-engineers the visual system from your screenshot and reorders hierarchy for your exact context. Sharper.
limit_zh: 只管视觉层，不碰后端逻辑或数据管道。输入得是页面/组件/截图，纯 API 或命令行界面它不接。产出到视觉稿为止。
limit_en: Visual layer only—no backend or data pipelines. Needs a page/component/screenshot input; pure APIs or CLIs are ignored. Output stops at visual.
